translated_title: Hurricane Polo Regains Category 5 and Maintains Rains in Six Pacific States
original_title: Huracán Polo recupera categoría 5 y mantiene lluvias en seis estados del Pacífico
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
meta_description: The storm sat 660 km from Cabo San Lucas, and forecasters warned of flooding, landslides and waves of up to three meters on the coasts of Baja California Sur, Nayarit and Jalisco.
